# Juan Canfield — AI Solutions Architect & AI Automation Consultant

> AI automation consultant and AI solutions architect for teams with real operational workflows. Fixed-fee AI systems roadmaps, custom AI development, productized AI Content Ops, and competitive/vendor intelligence platforms. Pricing and delivery scope are defined before build work begins.

## Productized AI Systems

- [AI Content Ops Station](https://juancanfield.com/systems/ai-content-ops): Productized AI content workflow — turns CRM, reviews, sales calls, and internal docs into approval-ready blogs, emails, sales briefs, reports, and landing copy. Quality gates and human review built in.
- [Ongoing optimization retainer](https://juancanfield.com/systems/ai-content-ops/ongoing-support): Productized monthly retainer for AI content workflow tuning. Starts at $2,500/month.
- [Atlas LLM Gateway](https://juancanfield.com/systems/atlas-llm-gateway): Hosted BYOK API for LLM cost control — exact and semantic cache, Anthropic batch, provider-billing reconciliation, budget guards, routing.
- [All productized systems](https://juancanfield.com/systems): Index of AI systems available as productized engagements.
